FN-RZF7NMY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 171
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/16/2024
House Bill 171 as introduced would decrease ad valorem tax receipts to the State General Fund,
Public School Fund, Veteran's Assistance Fund, and county and municipal funds beginning in
Fiscal Year 2026 by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of state or local ad
valorem tax otherwise assessed on certain civil aircraft that is both (1) over 30 years old, and (2)
owned by any person who is 65 years of age or older, which would be exempted by this bill.

FN-RZF7NMY-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 171
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/22/2024
House Bill 171 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would
decrease ad valorem tax receipts, beginning in fiscal year 2026, by a maximum cumulative total
of $1.8 million to the following funds by the estimated amounts listed, dependent upon the
amount of ad valorem taxes assessed on certain civil aircraft meeting the qualifications for
exemption under the provisions of this bill.
Source State County School Municipal Total
Public Schools Fund:
$120k
State General Fund: $100k
Maximum Veterans' Assistance Fund: $480k $630k $390k $1.8M
Ad Valorem $40k
Tax Loss
Alabama Historical
Commission: $400
Total: $260k
According to the Department of Revenue, a total of 1,910 aircraft over 30 years old were
assessed for ad valorem taxes in 2023; information regarding the age of the aircraft owner is
unavailable.
